scripts.postbuild: touch ./docs/.nojekyll; for ((depth = 0; depth < 7; ++depth)) ; do dots=''; level=$((depth-1 < 0 ? 0 : depth-1)); dots=$(printf %*s $level | sed 's^ ^../^g'); find_exactdepth $depth ./docs/ -type f -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 --no-run-if-empty sed 's^/_astro/^'$dots'_astro/^g' -i ; done
